author: evorthon-data maintainer
content: Hand authored artefacts with invented names, columns and values. No real, personal or confidential data, and no row taken from any system.

files.exported-job-credential.txt: A refusal sample carrying an invented, generic secret-shaped assignment. It is not any supplier's key format and it opens nothing.
files.order-data-dictionary.md: A data dictionary describing the invented extract, its reference data and the target output.
files.orders-extract.csv: Five invented order rows, read with the standard delimited reader.
files.settled-orders.sql: A script naming the step between the extract and the report.

purpose: The artefacts one scripted intake round reads, so artefact intake, the credential refusal and the round itself run with no environment and no model provider.
source: Artefacts written by hand for one scripted intake round, with invented names, columns and values and no row taken from any system.
